definitions.explanation: The inner sense of right and wrong that guides a person's actions. Used similarly to the English word "conscience" in both everyday and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {良心|りょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧。
{良心|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧すべきだ。
examples.english: You should act according to your conscience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{良心|りょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呵責|かしゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられ→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ず、⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告白|こくはく}した→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧。
examples.english: Unable to bear the pangs of conscience, he confessed everything.

notes:
USAGE:
Note the homophone ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧ (parents) — context usually makes the distinction clear.

{良心|りょうしん} is used in similar expressions as English "conscience": it can ache (⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧), prick (⟦{咎|とが}める→咎める：05346_togameru⟧), or cause torment ({呵責|かしゃく}). The expression {良心的|りょうしんてき} (conscientious) is commonly used to describe fair pricing or honest business practices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {良心|りょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧: to feel pangs of conscience
- {良心|りょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咎|とが}める→咎める：05346_togameru⟧: to have a guilty conscience
- {良心|りょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{呵責|かしゃく}: pangs of conscience, remorse
- {良心的|りょうしんてき}な⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: fair/reasonable price
- {良心|りょうしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow one's conscience
